commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' The game has begun to heat up. Martin Satriano (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+9' The referee blows his whistle as Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+8' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+8' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+8' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
90+8' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+7' Adrian Liso (Getafe) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
90+3' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Munoz (Getafe) replacing Luis Milla.
90+2' Atl. Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
87' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.
85' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Diego Rico (Getafe).
84' It looks like Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Ortiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
83' Here comes a substitution. Domingos Duarte is given a rest as he is replaced by Diego Rico (Getafe).
82' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' Luis Milla (Getafe) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Juan Musso makes a great save to stop his effort.
77' That's a well-taken pass by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
77' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Adrian Liso (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Mauro Arambarri and he is replaced by Mario Martin (Getafe).
74' Substitution. Adrian Liso receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luis Vazquez (Getafe) walks off.
73' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Alex Baena will be replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
73' It is time for a substitution. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is on for Obed Vargas.
72' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
67' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
67' Koke (Atl. Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
67' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
66' The substitution is prepared. Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marc Pubill.
66' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Alexander Sorloth is replaced by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
66' Substitution. Thiago Almada makes his way off the pitch and Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
64' Koke (Atl. Madrid) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
64' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) took the corner.

64' The referee points to the corner flag and Atl. Madrid will take a corner. A loose ball is pounced on by Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria is alert and makes a comfortable save.
63' Atl. Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
62' Close! Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
61' Jose Bordalas Jimenez appears to have said too much and referee Miguel Ortiz comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
60' Zaid Romero (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.

57' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post.
55' This is a yellow card! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
55' Referee Miguel Ortiz seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Abdel Abqar (Getafe).
54' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Abdel Abqar (Getafe)! Let's see what he decides.
51' Close! Luis Milla (Getafe) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
51' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
48' Dangerous play by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid). Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Martin Satriano (Getafe) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Veljko Birmancevic comes on the pitch for Kiko Femenia (Getafe).
46' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Golden chance! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
44' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
43' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
39' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Ortiz saw the whole situation.
30' Djene (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
29' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
26' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
26' Koke (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

25' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. David Soria sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
24' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
22' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
20' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
18' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
16' Atl. Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
12' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 74:26.
10' David Soria is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid). Easy save!

8' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. David Soria just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
6' Atl. Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Miguel Ortiz stops the game and makes a call.
2' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
2' Atl. Madrid take a short corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
